name: Sawarabi Miumi
source:
Likes: Love doramas, onigiri.

Miumi is a 3rd grader at Ayazono Gakuin High School.
[url=/c11811]Haruto[/url]'s younger cousin and a close friend of [url=/c11715]Asuka[/url].
She is super shy and bashful. When she is embarrassed she becomes stiff and hides behind the backs of people she knows well. She has a habit carry a notepad with her and take notes on anything. Miumi wanted to become a scenario writer, but it was a long time ago...

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/5/chara.html]the official site[/url].]
